chunks: And it has been narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
But if you perceive in them sound judgment, then deliver their wealth to them.
He said: "Perceiving sound judgment means safeguarding wealth."

key_terms.أَمْوَالَهُمْ: their properties, referring to the wealth to be returned to them
key_terms.الْمَالِ: wealth or property entrusted to a person
key_terms.رُشْدًا: sound judgment or maturity sufficient for responsible conduct

ai.seo_question: What does "sound judgment" mean in Qur'an 4:6 regarding the property of orphans?
ai.summary: This narration explains that the Qur'anic criterion of rushd in the case of orphans is demonstrated by the ability to preserve and manage wealth properly. It indicates that financial maturity is a practical sign for handing over property.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5523 - It was narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), that he was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted and Glorious:
"But if you perceive in them sound judgment, then deliver their wealth to them"
(Surah An-Nisa 4:6).
Imam (as) said: "Perceiving sound judgment means the ability to safeguard wealth."
